title: Tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire, while Russia claimed a drone strike on a cargo vessel in the Black Sea.
x_post: Tanker hit by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, fire reported; Russia claims drone strike on cargo vessel in Black Sea. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #BlackSea #Seafarers
